def: to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing)

words.word: when they had broken it up

occurrences.text: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
words: when they had broken it up

occurrences.text: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
